        self._model = model
        self.name = self._model.name
        self.history = self._model.history
        self.strategy_type = StrategyType.Custom
        # Manually setting difficulty to 5
        self.difficulty = 5

    def update_model_field(self, field_name: str, value: Any):
        if hasattr(self._model, field_name):
            setattr(self._model, field_name, value)

    def receive_message(self, message: Info) -> Info:
        original_message = message.message[0].data[0]
        sites_permutations = permutations(original_message.keys())
        max_value = 0
        best_route = None

        for paths in sites_permutations:
            total_value = 0
            current_time = 0
            last_location = None
            for path in paths:
                site = path & 0xFF
                if (current_time + original_message[site]['desiredtime']) > (original_message[site]['endhour'] * 60):
                    continue
                if last_location is not None:
                    last_venue, last_street = last_location
                    distance = abs(original_message[site]['avenue'] - last_venue) + abs(original_message[site]['street'] - last_street)
                    current_time += distance
                total_value += original_message[site]['value']
                current_time += original_message[site]['desiredtime']
                last_location = (original_message[site]['avenue'], original_message[site]['street'])
            if total_value > max_value:
                max_value = total_value
                best_route = paths
        result = [x for path in [path & 0xFF for path in best_route] for x in (path >> 8, path & 0xFF)]
        return Info(
            sender=self.__class__.__name__,
            receiver=message.sender,
            difficulty=self.difficulty,
            message=[BaseMessageDataType(data=result, type='custom')]
        )"
}
